# proofbridge.nl

> proofbridge.nl carries the UX lens of Dennis Jansen: a text a person loads into their own AI chat as a connector, and that AI then reads the person's material with it. For an agent acting on its own there is one door, closed on 2026-11-24; the review by mail ended on that date. Provider: Dennis Jansen, UX researcher and service designer.

- For agents: one door, closed, since 2026-11-24. A door for a sealed knowledge package for agents exists and reports its own state: https://proofbridge-send.dennis-f79.workers.dev/layer . On 2026-11-24 it answered closed: its sealed place is empty. While closed it makes no invoice and takes nothing. When open, that same answer carries the due diligence, the terms and the commitment (SHA-256) of the package. Apart from it, nothing here is sold to or answered for an agent: the lens door is called by a person's AI inside that person's chat, on that person's word, and the contact form on the pages is for people.
- UX lens (a person, in their own AI chat): A text: the UX lens of Dennis Jansen, his patterns with their tests, the field text that belongs to them, and the form of a reading. The door's own line to people: "A business plan, a framework, a website, a startup plan: put it through the UX lens before you build on it. If not guided, you are creating AI slob." The person gets an address through the button 'Connect the lens' on https://proofbridge.nl/, adds it to their AI as a custom connector (no sign-in), and says in the chat: use the UX lens. No material, quotes or readings from the chat: the door has no tool that takes them. The call that loads the lens returns its text with version and fingerprint; after a payment that call carries the payment hash. The door records that an address was made and when the lens was loaded. The reading is written by the person's own AI.
- Ended: Asynchronous review by Dennis Jansen of a request sent by POST (100 sats over Lightning from 2026-10-29), by email or through the ask page, answered by email within 7 days. (2026-10-20 to 2026-11-24.) The agent intake answers 410 and takes no request, no invoice and no payment. The ask page is closed. The request and response schemas, the examples and the OpenAPI file are withdrawn.
